thread:
maria-support: Heads-up — small startup on free tier (internal id: acct_9x) hit repeated 429s during a scheduled investor demo 10m ago. They reported 'requests failing mid-stream'.

ben-sales: Oof. Do we have logs/headers from their requests? They said they were on an hour-long demo with batched calls.

maria-support: They attached a curl repro. Short snippet they gave:```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-demo" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate``` Response had a `429` with body: `rate limit exceeded`. Headers included: `x-rw-remaining: 0`, `x-rw-limit: 60/min`, `x-rw-reset: 38`

leo-eng: tagging @ops-oncall for infra side. Low-hanging: free tier is 60 req/min per acct by default. Are they doing parallel streams or lots of small requests?

maria-support: They said parallel streams from multiple teammates, and they were doing short streaming calls (token-per-chunk). We think bursts pushed them hard. Customer asked if we can temporarily raise their cap for the next 2 hours so the rest of the demo can finish.

ops-oncall: I can do a one-off soft override for throughput for 2 hours if approval from sales. It'll create a temporary policy in the rate-limiter config. Will need account id + desired cap. Note: this bypass is tracked in audit logs.

ben-sales: I can approve a temporary bump to 300 req/min for 2 hours and follow up with a sales conversation about upgrading to our Pro plan. Maria, send me the account id and the demo ETA. I'll also create a support ticket with billing contact.

maria-support: Account id: acct_9x, demo ETA: 90 minutes remaining, currently 10m into issues. Customer contact: demo@startupx.com. Please escalate now.

leo-eng: Quick check — can you paste the exact 429 payload and headers? Need to rule out a bug where KV cache pressure causes false 429s.

maria-support: Here's the raw reply they copied:```HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-RW-Limit: 60/min
X-RW-Remaining: 0
X-RW-Reset: 38
{"error":{"type":"rate_limit_exceeded","message":"Rate limit exceeded for endpoint /v1/generate"}}```

ops-oncall: Headers look legit — enforcement came from the rate-limiter service, not the serving runtime. I can flip the temporary override now. Will take ~20s to propagate.

ben-sales: Please proceed. After override, can we set a short-lived quota for them tied to a payment method to avoid repeated manual bumps?

maria-support: We don't have a card on file. Customer is willing to switch to paid if we make the demo succeed. Wants a 2-hour replay window.

ops-oncall: Done. Temporary policy `override_acct_9x_171980` applied: cap -> 300 req/min, expires in 2h. Audit id: aud_5b2.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rate-limiter: policy override applied for acct_9x by ops-oncall at 2024-06-15T14:12:03Z.

maria-support: Customer confirmed calls are succeeding again, no more 429s. They say latency is a bit higher but acceptable. Thanks team :tada:

leo-eng: I'll monitor metrics for anomalies. If we see sustained sudden spikes from free accounts after this, we should consider tightening synthetic heuristics or adding a friction step (email verification) before transient bump.

ben-sales: I'll schedule a quick follow-up call to convert them — note the demo went well once we allowed the short burst.

maria-support: Notes for the ticket (for accuracy): repro commands, sample 429 headers, temp override applied, customer happy for now, sales follow-up required.

leo-eng: One more thing — @ops-oncall, can you drop the rate-limiter logs for the 10:00–10:15 window into the ticket? I want to check if we hit the banked burst tokens or strict per-minute buckets.

ops-oncall: Will attach logs and rate-limiter metrics (requests/min, 429 rate) to the ticket in ~10m.

maria-support: Closing loop here — customer will either sign up for paid tier or we revert to free limits after 2 hours. If anyone sees repeated pattern from acct_9x, ping me and I'll coordinate escalation with sales + security.

ben-sales: Thanks all. Quick checklist for the ticket: (1) temp override details, (2) billing contact, (3) follow-up plan, (4) any infra notes.

maria-support: Done. Ticket created #SUP-4829. Linking logs now.

leo-eng: Thanks. I'll watch for any anomalies and #SUP-4829 will be my single source for follow-up.

maria-support: thread locked.
